story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain from code, not observed. A camera head atop a tower turns while its round display pans the dry land, then pulls back to the whole tower and its ring. 16 of 56 lens rings light. In the display a plume rises and a flag locks on it. An alert card slides out to a truck below and lands as a bubble on the dash phone in the cab. The dash clock shows a hatched window up to ten minutes, marked estimated. In the display the plume keeps burning under the locked flag. Wide, a dashed line from the truck's landed alert stops well short of a fire-station badge and a Can share tag pins under it. A calendar clipped under the visors has no red mark. A blank record lies on the tailgate. The plan folder waits on state approval above the display, the landed alert and the still-open line.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on what the camera sees and shows the alert reaching the crew truck by about 17 s. It carries the same truck through the limits and ends on a composite with the line to responders visibly open under the pending plan.
story_review.weakest_transition: s4-shot-2 to s5-shot-1: from the dash clock in the cab straight back into the lens display with no physical bridge.
